doc: M1 data snapshot quality gates + gap protocol (M1.2/M1.3/M1.4)

manifest.assertion_contract: runner computes sha256 over manifest bytes at setup and refuses on mismatch (M1.5)

integrity.integrity_note: monthly kline archives are CSV-only: no inner .CHECKSUM files exist (666/666 absent by design); integrity = sha256 over raw zip bytes (manifest) + zip CRC test; probe 2018-02-08/09/11 daily files confirmed same-origin holes are authentic (1/14/24 rows those days)

provenance_notes: mixed timestamp precision across monthly files: legacy ms epochs (2017-era) and newer µs epochs (>=2025 files); normalized to ms per row (norm_ms) before all cadence math

debut months are partial by trade-start (e.g. BTCUSDT 1h 2017-08 begins at spot listing mid-month, 356 rows); full-month matrix completeness judged on FILE existence, coverage spans reported per (pair,interval)
inner .CHECKSUM (Binance's own sha256 of CSV bytes) verified per zip; zip CRC test per archive

repair_probe.question: can daily kline files (same archive) fill the missing slots?
repair_probe.answer: NO — daily files mirror the identical holes (same origin of truth); holes are authenticated archive absence, not repairable from data.binance.vision
repair_probe.resolution: cause recorded; NO fabricated backfill (HL-8 honesty: single ground truth per bar); loader contract = windows frozen on ACTUAL bar indices (spec §4.3), missing bar = absent, never interpolated
